ladder.label: NEARING A HIGH
ladder.why: A daily bottoming setup did fire (swing low in, momentum turned up), but it's LATE — price is already extended above the cycle low (formed ~23 day(s) ago @ 206.0) and overbought (daily RSI 76, 3-day 82 & weekly 84). A momentum cross is a LAGGING confirmation: after a vertical run it only triggers once the move is mature, so the bottoming entry has already passed. This is a chase, not a fresh buy.
ladder.next: Don't initiate here. Wait for a pullback toward the 10-day average — or the next daily-cycle low to set up — for a lower-risk entry; hold if you're already long.
ladder.regime_line: Bigger picture: BULLISH — weekly momentum positive (investor cycle week 12 · daily cycle day 33).
ladder.summary_line: Short-term (daily): nearing a high. Bigger picture (with-trend): bullish.
points: Bigger picture is bullish (with-trend for a daily long)
Macro: US net liquidity neutral — no macro tilt on the odds
Swing low printed (buyers rejected the low)
Back above the 10-day average, and it's turning up

entry.text: You missed the bottoming entry — the low already formed and price is now extended and overbought (daily RSI 76, 3-day 82 & weekly 84). Don't chase; wait for a pullback to the 10-day average or the next cycle low. Hold if already long.
entry.text_zh: 已错过筑底入场——低点已经形成，目前价格已拉伸且超买（日线 RSI 76、3 日 82 与周线 84）。不要追高；等待回调至 10 日均线或下一个周期低点。若已持有则继续持有。

cycle_plain.translation_zh: 上一周期在后半段见顶（“右移”）——强周期见顶偏晚，属于健康上涨趋势的信号。

ladder.why_zh: 日线筑底形态确实已经触发（摆动低点出现、动量转向上行），但为时已晚——价格已显著高于周期低点（约 23 天前形成 @ 206.0）且已超买（日线 RSI 76、3 日 82 与周线 84）。动量交叉属于滞后确认：在垂直拉升之后，只有当走势已经成熟时才会触发，因此筑底入场早已错过。这是追高，而非新的买入。
ladder.next_zh: 此处不宜建仓。等待回调至 10 日均线附近——或下一个日线周期低点构筑成形——以获得风险更低的入场；若已持有则可继续持有。

ladder.eq_tip: How well-timed & low-risk THIS entry is — near the cycle high, a fresh momentum turn, and with-trend. Measured: entries near the pivot drew ~30% smaller drawdowns than chasers far above it — risk control, NOT a return forecast.
ladder.eq_tip_zh: 衡量当前入场的时机与风险——贴近周期高点、动量新近转向、且顺势。实测：贴近枢轴的入场，其回撤比远离枢轴的追高者约小 30%——这是风险控制，并非收益预测。

description.summary: Bank of Montreal provides diversified financial services primarily in North America. It operates through Canadian Personal and Commercial Banking; U.S. Banking; Wealth Management; and Capital Markets segments. The company offers checking accounts, savings, money markets and certificates of deposits, debit cards, overdrafts, digital banking, credit cards, loans, mortgages, investment and retirement options, and other banking services; and commercial banking products and services comprise various of financing options and treasury and payment solutions, as well as risk management products. It also offers investing, banking, and wealth management advisory; digital investing services; financial solutions for individuals, families, and businesses; offers investment management services to institutional, retail, and high net worth investors; and diversified insurance, and wealth and pension de-risking solutions. In addition, the company provides individual life, critical illness and annuity products, as well as segregated funds, and group creditor and travel insurance to customers; debt and equity capital-raising, loan origination and syndication, balance sheet management, treasury management, mergers and acquisitions advice, restructurings and recapitalizations, trade finance, and risk mitigation services, as well as a range of banking and other operating services. Further, the company offers research and access to financial markets for institutional, corporate and retail clients through an integrated suite of sales and trading solutions related to debt, foreign exchange, interest rates, credit, equities, securitization, and commodities; provides new product development and origination services, as well as risk management and advisory services for hedging strategies, including in interest rates, foreign exchange rates and commodities prices; and funding and liquidity management services. Bank of Montreal was founded in 1817 and is headquartered in Montreal, Canada.
